component.name: Claudometer
component.summary: Claude Code and Codex usage limits in the panel, without starting model turns to check

description.p: Shows one compact symbol-and-meter pair per provider in the COSMIC panel and a popup with every Claude Code and Codex rate-limit window, reset time, and freshness. Usage is read from Claude Code's local cache and the documented Codex App Server account endpoint; checking never starts a model turn.
